# Verifiedemail

VerifiedEmail offers real-time email verification and bulk email list cleaning services to ensure the accuracy and deliverability of email communications.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/verifiedemail/.

## Actions

- **Check Credits** (read-only): Retrieve the remaining verification credits.
- **Check File Status** (read-only): Check the status of a previously uploaded file.
- **Get 1-Click User Data** (read-only): Retrieve data for a user who has completed a 1-click signup flow.
- **Get Shared Credentials** (read-only): Retrieve a list of shared credential ids.
- **Get Shared Credentials** (read-only): Retrieve verified credential data shared by a user.
- **Update 1-Click Credentials**: Update 1-click credentials.
- **Verify Email** (read-only): Verify the deliverability and validity of an email address.
